_comment: make e2e (harness/dev/e2e.mjs) reads this. `scenes` are tracked films/scene/*.json that error in make snap-all TODAY, named with a reason, so the suite passes on this tree but fails the moment a NEW scene starts erroring. Shrink this list as a scene is repaired; do not add an entry for a scene you have not confirmed errors. `needsUnlockedFont` names scenes whose theme sets a paid, per-developer face (assets/fonts/local/, never fetched by `make fonts`), so their DOM signature is only reproducible on a machine that has that face; excused from the snap-all `changed` rule, nowhere else.
